Enbridge Acquires US Pipeline Assets for $2.55 Billion

Canadian energy company Enbridge has announced a deal to acquire Tallgrass Energy's crude oil business for $2.55 billion. The acquisition includes a 75 percent interest in the Pony Express Pipeline system, which transports oil to a major storage hub in Cushing, Oklahoma. This deal represents a further expansion of Enbridge's operations in the United States.
